ch03f-combining-and-change#9:
cents = int(input("Cents: "))
print(f"${cents / 100:.2f}")
quarters = cents // 25
cents -= quarters * 25
dimes = cents // 10
cents -= dimes * 10
nickels = cents // 5
cents -= nickels * 5
print("Quarters", quarters)
print("Dimes", dimes)
print("Nickels", nickels)
print("Pennies", cents)
print("Coins", quarters + dimes + nickels + cents)
